answer: Sybil admission is triaged like a mass-casualty surge: each agent must stake a costly, slashed deposit of basalt-mined compute credits before any transaction, so fake identities are deprioritized at the door. Reputation then flows as a receding tide, where only sustained, verified work raises an agent's priority score while dormant or duplicated identities sink. A bonded grove of trusted peers must co-sign each new entrant, making a thousand sybils cost a thousand real collateral deposits plus colluder signatures, though colluding groves remain the ceiling on this defense.
